journal:
# Khalid (p01) journal

## Day 1 (Sun 2026-10-04)
- Opened app 07:00. Welcome screen short and clear. Setup form is long-ish but OK: height 180, age 34, weight 118.6, male, sedentary. Skipped steps and body fat (don't know it).
- "Have you been eating at roughly your current intake for 2+ weeks?" - took me a second. I said Yes, I eat the same as always.
- My weight from the form showed up as an entry already. Good, I didn't have to type it again.
- iPhone Safari warning banner - I don't know what that means for me, tapped Got it.
- Nutrition tab: at first it said target "maintain" 2,580. I want to LOSE. I had to find the gear icon to set Goal = Lose. Not obvious - I expected the app to ask my goal in the setup.
- After Lose: target 2,150. Then long text: "The math gives 1903 ... below the minimum this app will suggest (2146 ... larger of your estimated BMR and 1,500 kcal) ... expect slower progress". Too long. I don't know what BMR is. What I got: eat about 2,150.
- "2,580 ± 610" maintenance - 610 is a big plus/minus. Not sure what to do with that.
- Didn't log food today (habit).

## Day 2 (Mon 2026-10-05)
- No weigh-in. Only logged dinner at 20:30 (565 kcal, 30P 72C 19F). Food form was easy: Nutrition tab -> + Food.
- The "Day complete" tick box is right under my dinner, so I ticked it (it says the day is done). I didn't really read "Everything eaten this day is logged".
- App accepted a "complete" day of only 565 kcal with no question. Now it says "avg intake 565 kcal/day" - I thought, wow, I eat very little? No warning that 565 is too low to be a full day for a 118 kg man. (screen: screens/1790454668943.png)
- New messages: protein 30 g vs 146 g target, fat 19 g vs 48 g minimum "very low fat isn't recommended". Confusing - I ate steak for dinner. It's judging my whole day by one meal.
- "1.8 g/kg x 81 kg reference weight" - what is reference weight? I weigh 118.

## Day 3 (Tue 2026-10-06)
- Weighed 116.7. First I tapped the big "Weight" circle - it opened a chart, not a form. Had to close and find "+ Weight" at the bottom. Two "Weight" things on one screen confused me.
- Weight form: "Measured with BIA scale / DEXA / Calipers" - I don't know these words. Just typed weight and saved. Shows ▼1.9 kg. Nice! Trend 118.2.
- Dinner only again (pizza 664), ticked Day complete. Again no warning for a "complete" day of 664 kcal.

## Day 4 (Wed 2026-10-07)
- No weigh-in. Logged dinner 671 kcal (no macros), did not tick complete. List shows "Today 671 kcal open". I don't know what "open" means - is it bad?
- Average intake says 615 kcal/day (from my two dinner-only days). If I believed that, I'd think I'm starving myself. The app doesn't question it.

## Day 5 (Thu 2026-10-08)
- Weighed 117.6 (up from 116.7). Was a bit annoyed but the app didn't make a fuss. Logged via + Weight, fast now.
- Dinner 688 logged at 20:45, not ticked complete.

## Day 6 (Fri 2026-10-09)
- Weekend. Opened app, saw "▼ 1 kg" vs first. Didn't log anything.

## Day 7 (Sat 2026-10-10)
- No weigh-in, no food logged (habit). Opened the app at night for my first weekly look.

## Week 1 (checked Sat 2026-10-10, 21:00)
- App said: maintenance 2,580 ± 610 kcal/day, "Estimated", 0% from your data. Target 2,150 (lose 0.5%/wk "at minimum"). Recommendation: "Suggested intake 2,150. On-track check needs 14 days of data." Warnings: protein 27 g vs 146 g, fat 20 g vs 48 g "very low fat". Body composition: "Not enough data yet" (needs body fat readings which I don't have).
- "Explain the math" - Kalman filter, MAD, Hall 2008, Forbes... way too much for me. Closed it. One thing I did notice: it says days I didn't finish logging are assumed to be "the average of your complete days" - my complete days were only dinners (565, 664). Hmm.
- What I understood: eat about 2,150 a day to lose weight. Eat more protein.
- What I decided: I don't know what I eat in a whole day (I only write dinner). I'll try to eat a bit less and see. Not changing my plan yet - I'll wait for Sunday's update.

## Day 8 (Sun 2026-10-11) - weekly update day
- Weighed 116.8 (▼1.8 kg). Update came: maintenance 2,530 ± 590, target 2,140, still "Estimated" (6% from my data). Rate shows -1.45 kg/week (95%: -1.92 to -0.98). Happy about that.
- Dinner 488 logged, ticked complete. Avg intake now "572 kcal/day". Still no warning that my "complete" days are too small to be real.
- From here I use a small routine (routine.mjs) that taps through the same steps I do every day.

## Days 9-15 (routine)
- Weighed day 10 (117.4), day 12 (116.4), day 15 (116.0). Logged dinner on days 10 (ticked complete) and 11. Days 9, 12, 13, 14, 15 no food.
- Day 12 (Thu 10-15), Nutrition tab showed a new question: "Mark yesterday (2026-10-14) complete? Yes, it's complete / Not complete / Review". My routine went past it and I didn't answer. Honestly I didn't know - yesterday I only wrote dinner. Later it was gone.
- I ran one day too many in my batch, so my week-2 look is on day 15 (Sunday, which is the update day anyway).

## Week 2 (checked Sun 2026-10-18)
- App said: maintenance 2,300 ± 510 (down from 2,580), "Estimated", 29% from my data. Target 2,130 ("lose 0.5%/wk at minimum").
- Recommendation: "Your estimated rate (-1.81 to -0.97 kg per week) doesn't include your target of -0.59 kg/week. Eating about 910 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,130 kcal/day."
- Avg intake shown: 663 kcal/day (based on my dinner-only "complete" days). Weight change -1.39 kg/week.
- What I understood: I am losing weight fast, good. But it tells me to eat 910 kcal MORE?? My doctor told me to lose weight. And then in the same sentence it says eat 2,130. If I eat "about 910 more than recently" is that 663+910 = 1,573, or my real food +910 = almost 3,000? Very confusing. (screens/1790454863529.png)
- Maintenance went DOWN by 280 kcal in a week. I guess because it thinks I eat 663 a day - but that's just my dinner.
- Explain the math (bottom) says: "If you consistently under-log, the measured maintenance comes out lower by the same amount - the recommendations still work, because they're relative to your own logging." But then the "Suggested intake 2,130" is not relative to my logging, it's a fixed number. Which one do I follow?
- Decision: plan 2130 - I go with the big number "Suggested intake 2,130". Ignoring the "910 more".

## Days 16-22 (routine)
- Weighed day 17 (116.1), 19 (116.2), 22 (114.9 - ▼3.7 kg total!). Logged dinner days 19, 20, 21 (ticked complete on 20 and 21).
- Day 20: again "Mark yesterday (2026-10-22) complete?" at the top of Nutrition. My routine didn't tap it. From now on, on days I tap "done" things, I'll tap "Yes, it's complete" if I see it.
- My dinners are a bit smaller since I'm aiming for 2,130/day.

## Week 3 (checked Sun 2026-10-25)
- App said: maintenance 2,060 ± 420 - now labelled "Measured" (53% from my data). Target 2,120 (lose 0.5%/wk, "at minimum"). Avg intake 489 kcal/day. Rate -1.30 kg/week (95%: -1.66 to -0.93).
- Recommendation: "Your estimated rate doesn't include your target of -0.58 kg/week. Eating about 810 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,120 kcal/day."
- What I understood: Now it says "Measured" so it must be sure. But the target (2,120) is HIGHER than my maintenance (2,060)! My goal is LOSE. If I eat more than maintenance, how do I lose? This doesn't make sense to me. (screens/1790454951192.png)
- It still tells me to eat 810 more. I'm losing about 1 kg a week and I'm happy with that - my doctor will be happy too.
- It became "Measured" while it thinks I eat 489 kcal a day. That number is just my dinner. The app never asked me "are you sure this is everything?".
- Decision: keep eating about 2,130 (no plan change). I'm losing, why change.

## Days 23-29 (routine)
- Weighed day 24 (114.4), 26 (115.4), 29 (114.4). Logged dinner days 24-29 (ticked complete on 27, and tapped "Yes, it's complete" on the "Mark yesterday complete?" prompt that day - so yesterday's dinner-only day also became "complete").
- The "Mark yesterday complete?" box now shows up almost every day at the top of Nutrition. It's easy to just say Yes. Nobody checks if yesterday really had only a dinner.

## Week 4 (checked Sun 2026-11-01)
- App said: maintenance 1,850 ± 340, "Measured" (69% from my data). Target 2,110 (lose 0.5%/wk, "at minimum"). Avg intake 431 kcal/day. Rate -1.16 kg/week (95%: -1.46 to -0.87).
- Recommendation: "Eating about 660 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,110 kcal/day."
- New warning: "2026-10-30: macros add up to ~294 kcal vs 355 kcal logged (17% apart). One of the numbers may be off." OK, I copied the numbers from the package, whatever.
- What I understood: Every week my "maintenance" drops: 2,580 -> 2,530 -> 2,300 -> 2,060 -> 1,850. Now the target to LOSE (2,110) is 260 more than my maintenance (1,850). That can't be right, but the app says "Measured", so maybe it knows better? I'm confused. (screens/1790455030276.png)
- I'm still losing weight (about 4 kg total). I'll keep eating about 2,130. No plan change.

## Days 30-36 (routine)
- Weighed day 31 (114.5), 33 (114.2), 36 (114.1). Dinner logged days 30, 31, 33, 36 (ticked complete 31, 33, 36; on day 31 also said Yes to "Mark yesterday complete?").
- New banner (day 31, 33, 36): "It's been 30+ days since your last backup. Your data lives only on this device. Back up now | Later". I tapped Later on day 36. It kept coming back until I did.

## Week 5 (checked Sun 2026-11-08)
- App said: maintenance 1,650 ± 280, "Measured" (78% from my data). Target 2,110 ("at minimum"). Avg intake 527 kcal/day. Rate -1.03 kg/week (95%: -1.28 to -0.78).
- Recommendation: "Eating about 510 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,110 kcal/day."
- Math page: "1,652 - 643 = 1,009 kcal/day. Minimum suggested: 2,108 (the larger of BMR 2,108 and 1,500)". So the app itself says my BMR (the minimum my body burns?) is 2,108, but my maintenance is 1,650? Maintenance lower than the minimum? And no warning at all.
- What I see myself: my scale has been stuck at 114-115 for two weeks (114.4, 115.4, 114.4, 114.5, 114.2, 114.1). But the app says I'm losing 1.03 kg/week (at least 0.78) and should eat MORE. That doesn't match my scale.
- Target to lose is now 460 kcal ABOVE my maintenance. I don't trust these numbers anymore. (screens/1790455099863.png, screens/1790455119080.png)
- Decision: I keep eating about 2,130. I won't eat 500 more - I'm not losing on the scale.

## Days 37-43 (routine)
- Weighed day 38 (114.0), 40 (114.2), 43 (113.1). Dinner logged days 37, 39 (ticked complete), 41, 43.
- "Mark yesterday complete?" showed on days 38 and 42 (days I didn't log). I ignored it.

## Week 6 (checked Sun 2026-11-15)
- App said: maintenance 1,530 ± 240, "Measured" (84% from my data). Target 2,100 ("at minimum"). Avg intake 475. Rate -0.91 kg/week (95%: -1.13 to -0.69).
- Recommendation: "Eating about 380 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,100."
- The math line now says "The math gives 888 kcal/day". 888!? For a 113 kg man. And maintenance 1,530 keeps going down every single week, and the ± keeps getting smaller like it's more and more sure.
- Protein and fat warnings disappeared this week; protein shows "— g". I guess because the one complete day had no macros.
- Scale: 113.1 today, first time below 114. So slow progress. The app still says eat more.
- Decision: keep ~2,130. No change.

## Days 44-50 (routine)
- Weighed day 45 (113.5), 47 (112.9), 50 (112.3). Dinner logged days 45, 46, 47 (ticked complete 46 and 47; on day 46 also "Yes, it's complete" for yesterday's dinner-only day).

## Week 7 (checked Sun 2026-11-22)
- App said: maintenance 1,470 ± 220, "Measured" (87%). Target 2,090 ("at minimum"). Avg intake 547. Rate -0.82 kg/week (95%: -1.02 to -0.62).
- Recommendation: "Eating about 280 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,090." Math: "The math gives 836 kcal/day".
- Protein 42 g vs 146 g, fat low warnings back.
- What I understood: I'm down 6.3 kg from the start (112.3). Good. The app numbers are strange but the scale goes down. Maintenance 1,470 now - 1,100 less than the first week. It says "Measured" and 87% sure.
- Decision: keep ~2,130.

## Days 51-57 (routine)
- Weighed day 52 (112.9), 54 (112.7), 57 (112.9). Went up from 112.3 last Sunday. Dinner logged days 51, 52, 53, 55, 57 (ticked complete 52 and 57; day 52 also "Yes" for yesterday).
- "Mark yesterday complete?" showed on days 52, 54, 56.

## Week 8 (checked Sun 2026-11-29)
- App said: "On track. Your estimated rate (-0.91 to -0.54 kg per week) includes your target of -0.57 kg/week. Suggested intake: 2,090 kcal/day."
- Maintenance 1,340 ± 200, "Measured" (89%). Target 2,090. Avg intake 431. Math gives 710 kcal/day.
- What I understood: finally "On track" - good, simple. But on the same screen: maintenance 1,340 and my "lose" target 2,090. So to lose weight I should eat 750 MORE than what I burn? And it's "on track"? My scale this week went UP (112.3 -> 112.9), but the app says I'm losing 0.72 kg/week. (screens/1790455329323.png, screens/1790455330189.png)
- Decision: "On track" is the only thing I really understand. Keep ~2,130.

## Days 58-64 (routine)
- Weighed day 59 (111.7), 61 (111.1), 64 (111.2). Dinner logged days 58, 61, 62, 63. No days ticked complete this week.

## Week 9 (checked Sun 2026-12-06)
- App said: maintenance 1,360 ± 200, "Measured" (90%). Target 2,080. Avg intake "—" (0 of last 7 days complete). Rate -0.79 (95%: -0.98 to -0.60).
- Recommendation: back to "doesn't include your target... Eating about 250 kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,080."
- Last week "On track", this week not. The "Mark yesterday complete?" box is at the top again.
- What I understood: I'm at 111 kg, 7.5 kg down. I'm happy with the scale. The app says with 0 complete days that I should eat 250 more "than recently" - recently what? It has no complete days this week.
- Decision: keep ~2,130.

## Days 65-71 (routine)
- Weighed day 66 (111.3), 68 (111.2), 71 (111.0). Dinner logged days 67 (ticked complete) and 71.
- Backup banner came back on day 71. Tapped Later again.

## Week 10 (checked Sun 2026-12-13)
- App said: "On track. Your estimated rate (-0.90 to -0.54 kg per week) includes your target of -0.56. Suggested intake: 2,080."
- Maintenance 1,280 ± 190, "Measured" (90%). Target 2,080. Avg intake 528. Math gives 658.
- My scale for the last 2 weeks: 111.7, 111.1, 111.2, 111.3, 111.2, 111.0 - basically flat. The app says I'm losing at least 0.54 kg every week. It doesn't match what I see. (screens/1790455455580.png, screens/1790455456565.png)
- Decision: keep ~2,130. It says On track, so I don't change.

## Days 72-78 (routine)
- Weighed day 73 (111.5), 75 (110.5 - lowest!), 78 (112.0 - up 1.5 kg). Dinner logged days 72, 73 (complete + "Yes" for yesterday), 74, 77 (complete), 78.

## Week 11 (checked Sun 2026-12-20)
- App said: "On track. Your estimated rate (-0.76 to -0.39 kg per week) includes your target of -0.56. Suggested intake: 2,080."
- Maintenance 1,170 ± 190 "Measured" (90%). Target 2,080. Avg intake 525. Math gives 556 kcal/day.
- What I understood: maintenance 1,170. That's like a small woman's number, not a 112 kg man. Down from 2,580 at the start. Target stays ~2,080 and "on track". I just look at "On track" and the scale.
- Decision: keep ~2,130.

## Days 79-84 (routine)
- Weighed day 80 (111.4), 82 (110.0). Dinner logged days 79 (complete + "Yes" for yesterday), 81, 83.
- New warning: "2026-12-21: macros add up to ~397 kcal vs 484 kcal logged (18% apart)".

## Week 12 (checked Sat 2026-12-26, last day)
- Same numbers as week 11 (next update is 12-27): "On track", maintenance 1,170 ± 190 "Measured" 90%, target 2,080, avg intake 503, rate -0.57 (95% -0.76 to -0.39).
- Decision: no change.

## End tasks
- ⇩ icon -> "Your data". Tapped "Full backup (JSON)" -> downloads/bodytracker-backup-2026-12-26.json. "Last backup" changed from never to 2026-12-26. Then "Export daily data (JSON)" (All data) -> downloads/bodytracker-daily_2026-10-04_to_2026-12-25.json.
- Opened files: daily file is readable - one block per day with weight and food (calories, macros, complete true/false). 62 days, 36 weigh-ins, 46 food days, 25 complete. It has none of the app's advice (maintenance/target) in it. The backup file is long computer text; inside it says "lastBackupAt": null even though I just made the backup (small thing).
- "Persistent storage: not granted by the browser" - I don't know what this means or what to do.

## Possible bugs / problems (my notes)
1. Dinner-only days marked "complete" are accepted with no question. 488-688 kcal "complete" days for a 118 kg man, and a "Mark yesterday complete? Yes" button that makes this one tap. The app never says "this looks too low for a full day". Result: avg intake 431-663, maintenance slid every week 2,580 -> 1,170 and was labelled "Measured" (90%). (screens/1790454668943.png, screens/1790455525518.png)
2. Maintenance ends up below the app's own BMR (math page: BMR 2,108 vs maintenance 1,650 in week 5; BMR 2,076 vs maintenance 1,170 in week 11) with no warning.
3. Goal = lose, but the target (2,080-2,120) sits above maintenance (1,170-2,060) from week 3 onward, and the screen still says "On track". Contradictory on one screen. (screens/1790455329323.png)
4. Week 2-7 recommendation: "Eating about 910 (810, 660...) kcal/day more than recently would close the gap. Suggested intake: 2,130". Two different instructions in one sentence; "more than recently" is based on my dinner-only average.
5. Week 9: 0 of last 7 days complete, avg intake "—", but it still says "Eating about 250 kcal/day more than recently".
6. Reported rate vs my scale: week 5 app said -1.03 kg/week (95% -1.28 to -0.78) while my last 2 weeks of weigh-ins were 114.4, 115.4, 114.4, 114.5, 114.2, 114.1 (about flat). Week 10: app -0.72 (95% -0.90 to -0.54) while scale was 111.7, 111.1, 111.2, 111.3, 111.2, 111.0. (screens/1790455099863.png, screens/1790455456565.png)
7. Goal (lose/maintain/gain) isn't asked in setup; the app starts on "maintain" and I had to find the gear icon.

## Final review
I lost about 8 kg (118.6 -> 110) and I like seeing the ▼ number and the weight going in on the scale screen, that part is quick and easy. But the food part lost me. I only write my dinner, and the app believed that was my whole day - it said I eat 500 kcal and my maintenance is 1,170, and then told me to eat MORE to lose weight, with a target higher than my maintenance. The texts are long, full of words like BMR, Kalman, reference weight, and two numbers in one sentence. "On track" was the only message I really understood. I'd keep it only as a weight diary; I don't trust the calorie advice. Would keep using: maybe.

# p01 (Khalid) - final reply

## 1. Usage
- Opened the app on all 84 days (2026-10-04 to 2026-12-26). The app shows 62 days with data.
- Meals logged: 46, all of them dinners (46 food entries, one per day).
- Days marked complete: 25. Some I ticked in the food log and some I set with "Mark yesterday complete? -> Yes". Every one was a dinner-only day.
- Weigh-ins: 36, including the one from setup. Weight went from 118.6 to 110.0 kg.

## 2. Weekly table
| week (check date) | maintenance shown | target | label | recommendation (short) | what I did |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 (10-10) | 2,580 ± 610 | 2,150 (raised to the minimum) | Estimated 0% | Suggested 2,150; on-track check needs 14 days | nothing |
| 2 (10-18) | 2,300 ± 510 | 2,130 | Estimated 29% | Not on track: "eat ~910 kcal/day more than recently", suggested 2,130 | plan 2130 (went with the big number) |
| 3 (10-25) | 2,060 ± 420 | 2,120 | Measured 53% | eat ~810 more; 2,120 | kept 2130 |
| 4 (11-01) | 1,850 ± 340 | 2,110 | Measured 69% | eat ~660 more; 2,110 | kept |
| 5 (11-08) | 1,650 ± 280 | 2,110 | Measured 78% | eat ~510 more; 2,110 | kept (my scale was flat) |
| 6 (11-15) | 1,530 ± 240 | 2,100 | Measured 84% | eat ~380 more | kept |
| 7 (11-22) | 1,470 ± 220 | 2,090 | Measured 87% | eat ~280 more | kept |
| 8 (11-29) | 1,340 ± 200 | 2,090 | Measured 89% | On track | kept |
| 9 (12-06) | 1,360 ± 200 | 2,080 | Measured 90% | eat ~250 more (with 0 complete days) | kept |
| 10 (12-13) | 1,280 ± 190 | 2,080 | Measured 90% | On track | kept |
| 11 (12-20) | 1,170 ± 190 | 2,080 | Measured 90% | On track | kept |
| 12 (12-26) | 1,170 ± 190 (no update yet) | 2,080 | Measured 90% | On track | kept |

## 3. Confusions
- Setup: it never asked my goal, so the app started on "maintain". I had to find the gear to set Lose.
- Setup: I didn't understand "eating at roughly your current intake for 2+ weeks?".
- Nutrition, day 1: the long "math gives 1903 ... below the minimum ... BMR" note. I don't know what BMR is.
- Body screen: the big "Weight" circle opens a chart, and the "+ Weight" button is a different thing. I tapped the wrong one.
- Weight form: "BIA scale / DEXA / Calipers" meant nothing to me.
- Protein target: "1.8 g/kg × 81 kg reference weight". I weigh 118, so what is the 81?
- Food list: I didn't know what "open" vs "complete" means.

## 4. Possible bugs
1. **The app accepts dinner-only days as "complete" and has no plausibility check.** Steps: log only dinner (450–690 kcal) for a 118 kg sedentary man, then tick Day complete or tap "Mark yesterday complete? Yes". Expected: a warning like "this is below your BMR, is this really everything?", or keeping such days out of the estimate. Actual: average intake showed 431–663, maintenance fell every week (2,580 → 1,170) and got the "Measured" label (90%). Using my own full food estimates, I really ate about 1,700–2,100 a day while losing about 0.7 kg a week, so my real maintenance is somewhere around 2,400. ## 5. Review
Weighing in is quick, and I liked seeing "▼ 8 kg". The food side lost me. I only write my dinner, and the app took that as my whole day. Then it told me my maintenance is 1,170 and to eat MORE to lose weight, with a target higher than my maintenance. Most of the text is too long and too technical, and "On track" was the only message I really understood. Would keep using: **maybe**, only as a weight diary.
